scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && tsx --test packages/shared/test/images.test.ts packages/shared/test/filters.test.ts frontend/test/portrait.test.ts frontend/test/contactLinks.test.ts frontend/test/seo.test.ts backend/test/api.features.test.ts test/handover.integration.test.ts test/handover.pages.test.ts test/public-site.live.test.ts
scripts.test:handover: npm run build -w @kestrel/shared && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/handover.integration.test.ts test/handover.pages.test.ts test/handover.admin-pages.test.ts test/route-errors.live.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kestrel/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
